lesson.title: Time-Locked Treasure Chests
lesson.topic: Teaching the concept of time-lock contracts in Bitcoin and how they ensure secure, timed-release transactions.
lesson.steelman: How can we design a system that prevents both premature access and permanent loss of funds using blockchain technology?
lesson.example: Explaining how a user might use a time-locked contract to safely store an inheritance or important asset until a specified date arrives.

rationale: Introduces advanced Bitcoin security concepts in an accessible way, enhancing users' understanding and application of digital self-sovereignty.
